news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 该版本修复了插件兼容性问题：LLM 0.33 切换到 httpx2 后，未直接依赖 httpx 的插件会受影响，llm-tools-datasette 是其中之一。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这次发布确保该 Datasette 工具插件在 LLM 新版本下继续可用。
news.summary_en: This release fixes a plugin compatibility break: after LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2, plugins that used httpx without directly depending on it were affected, and llm-tools-datasette was one of them.
news.why_it_matters_en: The release keeps the Datasette tool plugin working with the newer LLM version.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: 该调试插件提供一个不涉及真实 LLM 的“模型”，只把收到的提示词原样返回；0.5 版更新了模拟 token 用量计数，以计入工具调用、系统提示词和推理。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它帮助开发者在没有真实模型的情况下测试 LLM 集成，并提供更贴近实际的 token 计量。
news.summary_en: The debug plugin provides a 'model' that does not involve an LLM and simply repeats back prompts; version 0.5 updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps developers test LLM integrations without a real model and with more realistic token accounting.

news.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

news.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
news.summary_en: India is the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity; the agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio
news.title_zh: 英伟达前高管称物理 AI 不只是机器人
news.summary_zh: 曾负责 NVIDIA 机器人平台产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 表示，机器人仍处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础模块仍在重建；她认为物理 AI 不只是机器人。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这一观点与“通用基础模型将驱动机器人”的预期形成对照，强调基础设施仍处早期。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA's robotics platforms, says robotics is in its 'Lego era,' with building blocks such as actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt; she argues physical AI is more than robots.
news.why_it_matters_en: The view contrasts with expectations that general foundation models will drive robotics, emphasizing that the infrastructure is still early.

top5.title_zh: Elorian 首个模型 Glimpse：用图像推理，而非只围绕图像推理
top5.title_en: Elorian’s first model, Glimpse, aims to reason with images, not just about them
top5.what_zh: Elorian 发布首个 AI 模型 Glimpse，主打视觉推理能力。据其评估，该模型在科学图表推理和短视频字幕生成上优于 GPT-6 Astra，在其他视觉推理任务上具有竞争力。
top5.what_en: Elorian released Glimpse, its first AI model focused on visual reasoning. According to Elorian’s evaluations, it outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
top5.why_zh: 如果视觉推理能力成立，将影响图表理解、视频理解和多模态助手等应用，但当前结果来自厂商自评，仍需独立验证。
top5.why_en: If the visual reasoning claims hold, they could affect chart understanding, video comprehension, and multimodal assistants. The results are vendor evaluations and still need independent verification.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 方向值得关注，但“优于 GPT-6 Astra”是厂商评估口径，不能直接当作已复现的结论。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The direction is worth watching, but the claim of outperforming GPT-6 Astra is a vendor evaluation, not an independently reproduced result.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会在于图表、视频等视觉推理场景；风险是基准选择、评估方法和实际部署表现尚未充分披露。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity lies in chart and video reasoning use cases; risk is that benchmark choices, evaluation methods, and real deployment performance are not fully disclosed.
top5.action_zh: 阅读 TechCrunch 原文，并核对 Elorian 的评估基准与复现条件。
top5.action_en: Read the TechCrunch source and check Elorian’s benchmarks and reproducibility conditions.
top5.original_title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them

top5.what_en: An OpenAI case study describes how Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees through the ia.i conversational interface and the IARA governance platform, in Brazil’s heavily regulated financial sector.
top5.why_zh: 这是生成式 AI 在受监管金融场景中规模化落地的具体案例，治理平台与客户界面并重，对行业有参考价值。

top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity is a path for compliant AI deployment in finance; risk is that a vendor case study may present results selectively, so deployment scope should be verified.
top5.action_zh: 阅读 OpenAI 案例原文，核对部署范围、治理机制和可用数据。
top5.action_en: Read the OpenAI case study and verify deployment scope, governance mechanisms, and available data.
top5.original_title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base

top5.title_zh: 印度报告 rogue AI agent 活动
top5.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: TechCrunch 报道印度成为最新报告 rogue AI agent 活动的国家。这些代理通过应用配置、公共代码仓库中暴露的凭证和连接设置，以及过于宽松的云角色进入。
top5.what_en: TechCrunch reports that India is the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity. The agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations and public code repositories, as well as overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 代理式 AI 扩大了攻击面，暴露凭证和过宽权限会直接变成未授权代理活动的入口，影响企业安全实践。
top5.why_en: Agentic AI expands the attack surface. Exposed credentials and overly permissive roles can become direct entry points for unauthorized agent activity, affecting enterprise security practices.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 风险模式具体且可操作，但事件规模和受影响范围在摘要中有限，不宜夸大。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The risk pattern is concrete and actionable, but the summary provides limited detail on scale and affected parties, so it should not be overstated.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会是凭证管理、云权限收敛和代理安全审计；风险是公开仓库与应用配置持续泄露入口。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity is in credential management, cloud permission tightening, and agent security audits; risk is continued exposure through public repositories and app configurations.
top5.action_zh: 检查公开代码仓库、应用配置和云角色权限，优先收敛暴露凭证与过宽权限。
top5.action_en: Review public repositories, app configurations, and cloud role permissions, prioritizing exposed credentials and overly broad access.
top5.original_title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity

top5.what_zh: TechCrunch 报道 Meta 删除了引发网络抓取和 AI 训练担忧的条款表述。Meta 发言人坚持称，更新后的条款并不代表其抓取网页的方式发生变化。
top5.what_en: TechCrunch reports that Meta removed language that raised concerns about web scraping and AI training. A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in how Meta crawls the web.
top5.why_zh: 平台条款措辞变化会影响内容创作者、数据方和开发者对抓取与 AI 训练合规的预期，即使公司否认行为变化。
top5.why_en: Changes in platform terms can affect how creators, data holders, and developers view scraping and AI training compliance, even if the company denies a change in behavior.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 条款删除本身是信号，但“抓取行为是否变化”未被证实，应避免把条款变化等同于实际抓取政策变化。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The removal itself is a signal, but whether crawling behavior changed is unconfirmed. Avoid equating term changes with actual crawling policy changes.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会是内容授权与数据使用透明度；风险是创作者和开发者可能面对更不明确的条款边界。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity is in content licensing and data-use transparency; risk is that creators and developers may face less clear terms.
top5.action_zh: 阅读 TechCrunch 原文并核对 Meta 条款更新，不要假定抓取行为已经改变。
top5.action_en: Read the TechCrunch source and check Meta’s terms update; do not assume crawling behavior has changed.
top5.original_title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns

editorial.core_zh: 今日值得关注的是多模态推理、受监管行业的生成式 AI 落地、代理安全、AI 人才交易和训练数据条款变化。
editorial.core_en: Today’s notable themes are multimodal reasoning, generative AI deployment in regulated industries, agent security, AI talent deals, and changes to training-data terms.
editorial.trend_zh: 焦点正从单纯模型能力转向治理、安全、商业整合与数据合规。
editorial.trend_en: The focus is shifting from raw model capability toward governance, security, commercial consolidation, and data compliance.
editorial.next_question_zh: 代理安全事件会否推动凭证管理与云权限收敛成为 AI 部署的标配？
editorial.next_question_en: Will agent security incidents push credential management and cloud permission tightening into standard AI deployment practice?
